atoms.a: I haven't been on a plane for many years now—far too many emissions! Instead, I choose closer destinations and travel by train. We can all do our part to reduce our consumption and protect our environment.

instruction.text: What topic is being discussed here? Select from the options.
instruction.sound: What topic is being discussed here? Select from the options.

atoms.a: Every year, more and more tourists visit us and we can now feel the impact in most places around New Zealand. I understand that tourism is a significant source of revenue for our country, but it is really starting to push local communities out of their neighbourhoods and I highly doubt it has a positive impact on the environmental challenges our oceans are facing.

instruction.text: Choose which ever term best reflects the speaker's statement.

atoms.a: ssml: <prosody volume = 'x-loud'>My parents want me or my brother to take over their business. In principle, I can imagine doing that, but there are so many other interesting options. Right now, I'm interested in studying law; financially, that would definitely be more lucrative in the long term. And then there's my band—we're playing really big gigs now. Who knows, maybe we'll actually get signed to a label. But working in the business on the side would hardly be possible then.</prosody>

instruction.text: What topic is being discussed here? Select from the options.
instruction.sound: What topic is being discussed here? Select from the options.

atoms.a: I have come to believe that we as a society; spend way too much time on our smartphones. Both adults and children spend hours on social media or in the fictional worlds of online games. Although these games are great fun, it would be better to play a game with real-life friends. Besides, hardly anything we see on the screen these days is real; so we should vastly increase the time we spend off the screen.
